name: Globe Industries Corporation
summary: Operating worldwide, Globe Industries Corporation focuses on the manufacturing and global trade of adhesive tapes. The company's diverse offerings include various PVC tapes, such as those for floor marking, can sealing, ductwork, electrical insulation, easy-tear embossing, pipe wrapping, protection/masking, hazard/warning, and wire harnessing. These PVC tapes are predominantly used for applications like wire insulation, cable splicing and termination, and degaussing coil wrapping. They also provide OPP stationery tapes, suitable for office use, fine arts, crafts, gift wrapping, hair styling, and exhibition displays, alongside a selection of general, easy-tear, and super-clear stationery tapes. For packaging needs, Globe Industries offers OPP tapes, including standard, printed, easy-tear, low-noise, super-clear, and colored versions, all designed for sealing boxes and bundling goods. Their extensive tape portfolio further features holding tapes, double-sided tapes, cloth tapes, cellophane tapes, and aluminum foil tapes. Moreover, the company supplies packaging accessories like tape dispensers and PE pallet/stretch wraps, as well as antistatic agents vital for different plastic coating processes. Globe Industries Corporation was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
